offers_products.reason: Sells propane fuel, delivered to tanks, plus tank exchange (Blue Rhino-style cylinders) and propane-powered solutions.

offers_services.reason: Propane delivery, tank setting, installation, inspection and 24/7 emergency service for homes and businesses.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential customers heat homes with propane delivered to tanks; cylinder exchange is sold to shoppers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves commercial, agricultural and industrial businesses with propane, and retailers carrying cylinder exchange.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers repeatedly refill tanks, with auto-fill delivery programs; propane is an ongoing consumable fuel.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home heating and business fuel are necessities; demand depends on weather more than economy.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent propane refills and cylinder exchanges.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for propane fuel, delivered with trucks and tanks, not staff expertise.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households and small local businesses, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs delivery truck fleet, bulk storage, customer tanks, cylinders and local distribution branches.
